title: Contract for {child}
intro: Please read the contract carefully. Is everything correct? Then sign below.
bookedDescription: Your child is in care on these days.
pdfDescription: The PDF is the contract you sign. It contains all terms.
withdrawalDescription: You conclude this contract online. That is why you have a right of withdrawal.
signDescription: With your signature you conclude the contract.
noticeConfirm: I have read the cancellation policy.
noticeRequired: Please confirm that you have read the cancellation policy.
earlyStart: Care should start before the withdrawal period ends.
earlyStartHint: If you withdraw later, you pay for the care up to then on a pro-rata basis.
signatureRequired: Please sign and confirm your signature.
signedTitle: Thank you. The contract is signed.
signedMail: You will receive a confirmation with the contract by email.
withdrawalUntil: You can withdraw from the contract until {date}.
earlyStartChosen: Care starts as agreed, also during the withdrawal period.
alreadyInForce: This contract is already in force. You do not need to sign anything.
invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
invalidText: The link was already used or has expired. Have you already signed? Then there is nothing to do. You can find the contract in the parent app under “Documents”, or ask the provider for a new link.
submitTooltip: Concludes the binding contract with the provider right away.
